name: card-select
prompt: A single playing card being lifted off a felt-covered card table, short soft paper slide with a gentle lift at the end.

name: card-place
prompt: A playing card placed firmly down onto a wooden card table, soft paper snap followed by a low felt thud.

name: card-recall
prompt: A playing card sliding back across a felt table toward the player's hand, gentle paper swish tapering off.

name: card-swap
prompt: Two playing cards exchanged between hands, a quick double paper flutter with a soft crossing motion.

name: card-rotate
prompt: A playing card twisted a quarter turn between finger and thumb against a table, two light paper flicks.

name: card-lock
prompt: A small metal latch clicking shut over a card on a board, crisp mechanical snap with a soft bright chime tail.

name: invalid-move
prompt: A dull knuckle knock on a wooden table, short muted double tap signalling a refused move.

name: edge-match
prompt: A bright small glass bell ting with warm resonance, like a glass mosaic tile settling exactly into place.

name: mosaic-complete
prompt: A warm rising cluster of tuned glass chimes resolving into a pleasant major chord, gentle celebratory finish with a soft shimmer tail.

name: round-fail
prompt: Three soft descending wooden marimba notes fading out quietly, gentle disappointment without harshness.

name: hint-reveal
prompt: A soft magical shimmer of light wind chimes with a rising glint, as if a hidden spot on a board lights up.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A cheerful ascending four-note glockenspiel fanfare ending on a bright sustained note, small award jingle.

name: pause-toggle
prompt: Two soft muted music-box plucks, high note then low note, like a small lid gently closing.

name: ui-open
prompt: A soft wooden panel sliding open, gentle airy whoosh ending with a light click.

name: ui-close
prompt: A soft wooden panel sliding closed, gentle hushed whoosh ending with a quiet click.
